page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at top with page number at right. At the foot, a signature "N 2" at left-centre and a catchword "Erudi-" at right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: Primum est de Fide, Pontifici Religio-nis Christianorumque omnium á Christo curam esse commissam. Hanc Doctrin-am quam quam in Libro isto purum pu-tum historicum me profitear, fuse non-nunquam instituta digressione confir-mavi, ut 2 part. c. antepenultimo, & 3. part.c.3.brevius sæpissime quotiescunque scilicet vel tenuissima occasio id ferre potuit.

Secundum est ex Ecclesiastica illa po-testate, temporalem indirecte sequi, quâ Pontifex, reges & principes, si Ecclesiam eversum eant, deponendi jus habet, quæ sententia omnium ferme est Theologorum; illam tamen Card. Per-ronius toto applaudente Episcoporum Francicorum cœtu, problematicam scripsit, contrariamque ab Ecclesia tolerari.

Tertium est Canonistarum, qui Pontificem totius orbis Dominum directum à Deo datum esse contendunt. Senten-tia ista, ab omnibus fere Theologis ex-ploditur; in ea refutanda plurimum la-borat Card. Bellarminus. Nunc autem

page.notes: Dark speckles and smudges along the left edge and a few marks at the right edge are scan damage or printing marks, not text, and are omitted. Some words are set with a long-s form that resembles f; they are transcribed as s. The number "3" in "3. part.c.3" is printed in an old, yogh-like form and is given as 3. The "2" after "ut" appears to be a superscript and is kept as printed.
